description: Page through Plaud recordings with optional filters.

after.description: Cursor from next_after of a previous response

folder.description: Folder ID (from `list_folders`); pass empty string for recordings in no folder

trash.description: List trashed recordings instead of active ones

name: browse_recordings

description: Find recordings whose transcript or summary mentions something, with a snippet around each hit. Keyword match with stemming, best match first. Plaud returns at most 20 matches per search (capped=true when that limit was hit); narrow since/until to reach others.

after.description: Cursor from next_after of a previous response

query.description: Words to find in transcripts and summaries

name: search_recordings

description: Fetch full detail for one recording. Transcripts are paged: while transcript_has_more, call again with transcript_after=transcript_next_after. A changed transcript_fingerprint between pages means it was edited; restart from 0.

include.description: Extra fields: transcript (text page), segments (structured page: index, speaker, text, start_ms/end_ms from recording start), speakers, summary (+ extra_notes: other summaries as {note_id, name, content}), audio_url, attachments

raw_markdown.description: Keep Plaud's raw summary markdown (plaud:// links) instead of [2:05] citations

transcript_after.description: Utterance index to start the transcript from; pass the transcript_next_after of a previous response to continue

transcript_block.description: Which transcript to return: 'transaction' (default; raw diarized transcript) or 'transaction_polish' (Plaud's AI-cleaned pass — filler words removed, punctuation repaired; same speakers and timestamps). Not every recording has a polished block; the response names what is available when the requested block is missing.

name: get_recording

description: Save a recording's whole transcript to a file and return its path, size and SHA-256 (not the transcript). json is the archive format; txt/srt/docx/pdf are Plaud's own exports. Copy the file as-is, never retype it. Pass the reviewed transcript_fingerprint as expected_transcript_fingerprint to refuse later edits.

expected_transcript_fingerprint.description: transcript_fingerprint from get_recording; a mismatch returns revision_conflict

output_path.description: File path, or folder to save <recording_id>.<block>.<format> in. Default: the app's exports folder

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at output_path

transcript_block.description: 'transaction' (raw) or 'transaction_polish'; never falls back to the other

with_speakers.description: Speaker labels (txt/srt/docx/pdf; json always has them)

with_timestamps.description: Timestamps (txt/docx/pdf; json and srt always have them)

name: export_transcript

description: Change one or more recordings: rename, trash, restore, move, or trim (keep only some ranges, as a new copy; a slow trim returns status='still_processing', do not call again). Also manages one recording's public share link: share_create (confirm=true; default 7 days, transcript only), share_get, share_update (confirm=true), share_revoke (confirm=true). Revoking keeps the URL: sharing again revives it.

clear_folder.description: When true, moves the recording out of its folder into Plaud's main Recordings list (use instead of a magic folder_id value)

confirm.description: Required for share_create, share_update and share_revoke, after the human agrees

folder_id.description: Folder ID (from `list_folders`); required for move unless clear_folder is true

recording_ids.description: Batch of recording IDs (trash/restore/move only, not rename); use instead of recording_id

share_days.description: Link lifetime in days from now (default 7)

name: mutate_recording

description: Permanently and irreversibly delete a recording.

confirm.description: Must be true; set only after the human has explicitly confirmed the permanent deletion.

name: delete_recording

description: Edit a recording's transcript. action='rename_speaker' relabels a speaker across all segments; action='correct' does a literal find-and-replace on transcript text (dry_run=true previews the match count).

dry_run.description: action=correct only: return the match count without editing

find.description: Exact literal text to find (case-sensitive); required for action=correct

new_name.description: Replacement speaker name; required for action=rename_speaker

original_label.description: Existing speaker label; required for action=rename_speaker

replace.description: Replacement text, may be empty to delete; required for action=correct

name: edit_transcript

description: Upload a local audio file to Plaud; returns the new recording_id. With attach_to, attaches a document instead.

attach_to.description: Recording ID to attach the file to (PDF, Office, text or image; max 15/2/20 MB)

file_path.description: Absolute path to the audio file or document

folder_id.description: Folder ID (from `list_folders`) to file the recording in

start_time.description: Millisecond epoch integer or ISO 8601 string; defaults to now

timezone_offset.description: Whole-hour UTC offset (e.g. -6); defaults to this machine's timezone

title.description: Recording title; defaults to file stem

name: upload_recording

description: List Plaud folders, returning id, name, color, icon, and parent_id for each.
name: list_folders

description: Trigger transcription and summarization for a recording; the `wait` mode controls how long to block (default: transcript). A processed recording is left unchanged (returns already_processed=true).

language.description: BCP-47 primary subtag (e.g. 'en', 'zh'); use 'auto' to detect

wait.description: How long to block: none/transcript/summary. One ~90s budget; if unfinished returns status='still_processing' with a job handle. Then poll get_recording instead of calling again.

name: process_recording

description: Merge two or more recordings into one new recording. If not done within ~90s, returns status='still_processing' with the merge job id; do not call again (it would merge twice).
name: merge_recordings

description: Edit a recording's AI summary, or an extra note via note_id. action='correct' does a literal find-and-replace on the raw markdown (shown [2:05] citations are plaud:// links; they are kept); action='replace' overwrites everything, so include any plaud:// links to keep.

content.description: Full replacement summary markdown; required for action=replace

dry_run.description: action=correct only: return the match count without editing

find.description: Exact text to find (case-sensitive, literal); required for action=correct

note_id.description: Edit this extra note (from get_recording) instead of the summary

replace.description: Replacement text (may be empty to delete); required for action=correct

name: edit_summary

description: Manage Plaud folders: create a new folder, edit an existing one's name/color/icon, or delete one. To move a recording into a folder, use mutate_recording(action='move') instead.

confirm.description: Required for action=delete; confirm only after the human agrees the folder should be deleted. Its recordings are kept and move to Plaud's main Recordings list.

folder_id.description: Folder ID (from `list_folders`); required for edit and delete

name.description: Folder name; required for create, optional for edit

name: mutate_folder

description: Manage Plaud's account-wide custom vocabulary (names, jargon that steer transcription): list, add, edit, or delete (confirm=true) words.

confirm.description: Required for delete, after the human agrees

heard_as.description: Misheard form to auto-correct to `word`; empty clears it on edit

word_id.description: Entry ID from list; for edit or single delete

name: mutate_vocabulary
